notes: Fixed a silent multi-account harvest failure: aiq_cache.db lives in a Google Drive sync folder by design, and Drive replaced the file underneath the already-running server process -- harvest_cache_accounts (the per-account table multi-account merging depends on) vanished, but the process's one-time schema-ready flag never noticed, so every harvest after that point failed with 'no such table: harvest_cache_accounts'. This is why a correctly-configured watchlist on a second Active IQ account (confirmed resolving 186 systems when queried directly against Active IQ with that account's own token) never appeared in the merged fleet view. _init_db() now does a cheap sqlite_master existence check on every call and self-heals by re-running the idempotent schema setup if the table is missing, without reintroducing the per-request slowdown the one-time flag was added to prevent. Also added a scope label to the Technical Health & Risk Mitigation (TAM) tab header showing the active customer/group/watchlist filter, so it's clear at a glance what the selected systems list is scoped to.
